usedFor: Cal ID holds booking requests and form submissions, and Freshsales Classic holds the deals that “Update Deal” changes.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Rescheduled” in Cal ID, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A reschedule can move the deal's expected close date, so the deal tracks the real meeting.

watchOut: “Update Deal” finds a deal by ID or name, so “Booking Rescheduled” must pass one of them.
